name: factory-mgmt
description: 工厂管理系统 - 成品/材料/包材库存 + 订单 + 账单 + 扫码出入库

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && (apt-get update -qq 2>/dev/null || true) && (apt-get install -y -qq python3 build-essential 2>/dev/null || true) && npm install
scripts.dev: cd server && npm run dev & cd client && npm run dev
